newsitem.title: USA: Oceaneering to build six new remote vehicles.
newsitem.headline: Oceaneering to build six new remote vehicles.

text.p: Oceaneering International Inc is to add six new remote vehicles to its fleet, two for the 10,000 feet plus deepwater and four for the 6,600 feet plus of water.

"These six vehicles raise the total number of new vehicles we have announced since December 1995 to thirty-nine, a 78 percent increase in the size of our work class ROV fleet," said Jay Collins, vice president of Oceaneering's Marine Oilfield Services division said in a statement.
Oceaneering provides engineered services and hardware for marine, space and other harsh environments. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
